description: This file contains unit tests for the MemoryDAG and MemoryDAGBuilder classes in the PyTorch JIT compiler, specifically testing memory aliasing and containment relationships between Value objects within computational graphs.

classes.name: MemoryDAGBuilder
classes.description: A helper class used to construct memory DAGs by creating values and establishing pointer or containment relationships.

classes.name: MemoryDAG
classes.description: Represents the memory aliasing graph with methods to check if two values may alias or if a value may contain another.

methods.name: makeFreshValue
methods.description: Creates a new, unique Value object based on the provided input Value.

methods.name: makePointerTo
methods.description: Establishes a pointer relationship from one value to another in the MemoryDAGBuilder context.

methods.name: addToContainedElements
methods.description: Adds a containment relationship indicating one value contains another.

methods.name: createMemoryDAG
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MemoryDAG object representing the current relations built.
